visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Let a TreeMap Do the Sorting
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The keys of a HashMap are copied into a list, sorted and looked up one by one. Use a TreeMap, which is already sorted. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A TreeMap is always iterated in key order, so the copy, the sort and the extra get call per key disappear. (A HashMap has no guaranteed order at all.)
